home.title: AgriLink AI
home.subtitle: Direct Agricultural Marketplace with Intelligent Logistics & Demand Forecasting
home.hero_desc: Empowering Indian farmers and institutional buyers with direct agricultural commerce, Prophet-powered demand forecasting, OSRM route sequencing, and computer vision produce grading.

how_to_use.title: How to Use AgriLink
how_to_use.step1_desc: Take a photo of your produce. Our AI will automatically check the quality.
how_to_use.step2_desc: Set your price based on our AI recommendations.
how_to_use.step3_desc: Buyers will place bulk orders. We aggregate small farmers automatically.
how_to_use.step4_desc: A shared truck will pick up your produce based on an optimized route.
